messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered P1: GPU memory pressure detected in pool infer-west2a (autoscale). Error: CUDA alloc failed. AlertID: PD-894721
pagerduty-bot: Incident created — page sent to eng-oncall.
lina: ack — looking.
lina: can someone post quick customer impact? any 5xx spikes?
ops-bot: Metrics snapshot (5m): infer-west2a memory_usage=96%, kv_evictions=12, latency.p95=+120ms, error_rate=0.8%
marco: I’m seeing repeated `c10::alloc` failures in the driver log, likely prefetch thrash causing transient OOMs. grabbing logs now.
amanda: tagging @runtime-team — was there a model rollout in this region in the last hour?
lina: running `kubectl get pods -n infer -o wide | grep infer-west2a` to list affected pods
```
kubectl get pods -n infer --selector=pool=infer-west2a -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,STATUS:.status.phase,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[*].restartCount,NODE:.spec.nodeName
infer-worker-72f9 Running 3 ip-10-0-2-45
infer-worker-9c3a CrashLoopBackOff 12 ip-10-0-2-46
infer-worker-a1b2 OOMKilled 7 ip-10-0-2-46
infer-proxy-01 Running 0 ip-10-0-2-47
```
marco: confirmed: two workers OOMKilled / CrashLoopBackOff with CUDA allocation errors.
lina: immediate mitigation: enable partial fallback routing to cpu-infer for new sessions to avoid customer impact.
```
# routing api (internal)
curl -X POST https://routing.internal/api/v1/reroute \
  -d '{"pool_from":"infer-west2a","pool_to":"cpu-infer","pct":15,"reason":"gpu memory surge"}'
```
amanda: applied routing rule — 15% new traffic -> cpu-infer. will ramp if metrics don't improve.
ops-bot: Reminder: PD will auto-escalate in 10m if no owner acknowledgement from L2.
tony: support: customer "adbase" reported = intermittent timeouts and longer tails ~30s in the last 6m. opened a ticket and notified customer.
lina: starting controlled drain of affected nodes: `./manage-pools drain infer-west2a --force --reason "OOM surge"`
```
manage-pools: draining nodes ip-10-0-2-46 (2 pods will be rescheduled), cordon=true
```
marco: concurrently scaling burst capacity in another region: `autoscaler --pool infer-west2b --scale-to 6 --reason "fallback capacity"`
amanda: rolling back model rollout: reverting model v3.2 -> v3.1 on west2a where new quantized variant went live 00:45 ago. kicking restart for those deployments.
lina: toggled prefetch window down to 50% for pool infer-west2a to reduce KV/cache warm-up pressure.
```
# sample kernel log lines
[2026-03-15T09:12:01Z] E CUDA: c10::alloc: failed to allocate 489MB (out of memory)
[2026-03-15T09:12:02Z] W GPU: eviction: kv_cache drop key=abc123
```
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-894721 escalated to L2 — paging @marco.
marco: handoff accepted. looking into allocator fragmentation vs. real memory exhaustion. pulling coredumps -> /var/crash/infer-west2a/*.core
lina: reroute holding at 15% -> observing error_rate drop to 0.1% and latency.p95 back to +30ms over 3m window.
tony: support update: "adbase" says timeouts stopped after 2:45pm, monitoring.
amanda: applied hotfix: disabled model prefetch on infer-workers in pool west2a (`ENV PREFETCH=false`) and performed rolling restart for pool selector label `pool=infer-west2a`.
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/infer-worker -n infer --selector=pool=infer-west2a
```
ops-bot: eviction rate normalized, memory_usage=68%, error_rate=0.05%.
lina: PD cleared — PD-894721 resolved at 1769981395.
marco: will own postmortem. immediate action items: 1) revert conservative prefetch tuning after stability, 2) add alert suppression for known brief rollout spikes, 3) run allocator stress test to reproduce fragmentation pattern.
lina: thanks team — filing follow-up: postmortem + runbook patch + customer follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident resolved — closing thread.
